::: {#def-feature-engineering}

#### Feature engineering

**Feature engineering** is designing by hand
the [features](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/course-overview.html#def-feature) that a model takes as input,
using what a person knows about the problem
[@goodfellow2016deep, Ch. 1].
Features made this way are also called hand-designed or hand-crafted features.

:::
